==Walkthrough==
[[File:Fenkencastle floor 2.png|thumb|The upstairs floor of the Fenkenstrain castle]]
[[File:Fenkenstrain experiment cave QG map.png|thumb|The experiment cave and path to the mausoleum.]]
[[File:Fenkenstrain QG map.png|thumb|Overview of the locations in the Fenkenstrain quest.]]
{{Checklist|*Start the quest by reading the [[signpost (Creature of Fenkenstrain)|signpost]] in the centre of Canifis or by talking to [[Dr Fenkenstrain]].
*Take a [[pickled brain]] off the table in the [[Hair of the Dog|tavern]] in Canifis for 50gp, or by using [[Telekinetic Grab]].
*Talk to [[Dr Fenkenstrain]] inside of [[Fenkenstrain's Castle]]. {{Chat option|1Yes.|4Braindead|4Grave-digging}}
*Go upstairs by the eastern or western staircase to the bookcases and read:
**''"The Joy Of Grave Digging"'' in the west bookcase. {{Chat option|4The Joy of Gravedigging}}
**''"Handy Maggot Avoidance Techniques"'' in the east bookcase. {{Chat option|2Handy Maggot Avoidance Techniques}}
**Combine the [[marble amulet]] and [[obsidian amulet]] to form the [[star amulet]].
*'''Right-click''' dig at the [[grave (Haunted Woods)|cross-shaped grave marker]] in the [[Haunted Woods]], south-east of Fenkenstrain's castle and immediately east of [[fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|alq}}.
**Be quick, the area is infested with [[Feral Vampyre|vampyres]]. Take a [[holy symbol]] and food for low levels.
*Combine the decapicated head and the pickled brain.
*Head north out of the Haunted Woods and use your [[star amulet]] on the easternmost [[memorial (Experiment cave)|memorial]] (south-east of Fenkenstrain's castle).
*Push the memorial to enter the [[Experiment Cave]].
*Inside, kill a level 51 [[Experiment]] for the [[cavern key]]. If you have started [[Rag and Bone Man II]], kill additional Experiments (level 25) for the [[Experiment bone]].
*Follow the north-western path to the end.
*Search the chest and climb the ladder.
*'''Right-click''' Dig at the three [[grave (Creature of Fenkenstrain)|grave]]s to get the [[torso]], [[arms]] and [[legs]].
*Return to Dr Fenkenstrain ([[Fenkenstrain's castle teleport]]) and give him the body parts. {{Chat option|1I have some body parts for you.}}
*Talk to him again to give him the needle and thread.
*Talk to the Gardener Ghost for the shed key (ensure ghostspeak amulet is equipped). {{Chat option|2Do you know where the key to the shed is?}}
*Search the [[Cupboard (Creature of Fenkenstrain)|cupboard]] inside the shed to get a [[garden brush]].
*Take 3 canes from the pile of canes next to the shed
*Use all the canes (3) on the [[garden brush]] to get an [[extended brush]] (using a total of 3 bronze wires).
*Go upstairs to the western fireplace and use the extended brush on the fireplace for a conductor mould.
*Go to a [[furnace]] (closest is in Port Phasmatys, teleport to Falador, fairy ring to [[Zanaris]], amulet of glory to Al Kharid, or [[Home Teleport]] to Lumbridge) and smelt a [[silver bar]] into a [[conductor]] (lightning rod).
*Return to the castle, go upstairs and then climb the southern ladder to reach the [[lightning conductor]].
*Repair the lightning conductor.
*Return to Dr Fenkenstrain and talk to him.
*Go upstairs, then through the metal door, then climb the northern ladder.
*Talk to Fenkenstrain's monster.
*Go downstairs, then pickpocket the doctor for the [[ring of charos]].
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}
